description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams and provides filtering parameters for employee reports, including employee number, project and activity IDs, and timesheet inclusion options. It also sets default sorting and validates input values.

classes.name: EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for filtering employee reports based on various criteria such as employee number, project, activity, and timesheet status.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number for whom the report is being generated.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the report filter.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the project filter if set.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID to filter reports by.

methods.name: getActivityId
methods.description: Returns the activity ID filter if set.

methods.name: setActivityId
methods.description: Sets the activity ID for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Returns the current timesheet inclusion filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter, validating against allowed options.
